alt: Your store looks good. Is it easy to buy from?
Looks good is not the same as easy. Many customers browse and buy on a phone. A store can look great and still make buying slow or unclear.
Buy something from your own store: Open it on your phone - Not on your computer.; Find a product - Starting from the home page.; Add it and check out - All the way to the end.
On every product page: Price; Options; Delivery; Photos
Hard vs easy to buy. Hard to buy: Delivery cost appears last; Many steps to pay. Easy to buy: Total clear early; Few steps to pay
Ask someone else to try it. You know your store too well. Hand your phone to a friend, say nothing, and watch where they hesitate.
Notes to write down: Where did they hesitate?; What did they not understand?; Which step felt slow?; What did they ask you?

caption:
Your store looks good. Is it easy to buy from? 📱

Looking good and being easy to buy from are two different things, especially when customers browse on a phone.

Try this mobile buying audit: open your store on your phone, find a product, add it to the cart and go all the way to checkout. Check that price, options, delivery and photos are clear on every product page. Then hand your phone to someone else and watch where they hesitate.
